user.title: Heating oil tank
user.description: Calculates the oil level from the burner runtime counter (for example the KM271 'Brennerlaufzeit 1').

data_description.runtime_entity: Total burner time sensor (min, h or s).
data_description.price_entity: Only used for oil without a price. Give the price with each delivery instead.
data_description.liters_per_cm: Volume for 1 cm on the tank gauge. Example: 35 cm = 1000 L gives 28.6.
data_description.low_alert: Below this volume, the low-level sensor is on and you get a notification.
data_description.flow_rate: Oil use per burner hour. Buderus G115/21 ≈ 2.3, G115/28 ≈ 3.0, G115/34 ≈ 3.8 L/h. Calibrate later with the gauge.
data_description.initial_gauge_cm: Value on the tank gauge (cm) now. This is the start level.

error.above_capacity: This gauge reading is more than the tank capacity.

abort.already_configured: This burner counter already has a tank.
